build_datarobot_config: build a DataRobotConfig instance to resolve api_base and api_key for datarobot chat completions
create_resolve_api_key: create a resolved datarobot api key from user input, secret manager, or fake fallback
build_resolve_api_base: build a resolved datarobot api base url with proper path and trailing slash

run_get_complete_url: run get_complete_url to return the full datarobot chat completions endpoint url
